newsitem.title: USA: Chinese license Carbide/Kvaerner oxo process.
newsitem.headline: Chinese license Carbide/Kvaerner oxo process.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said Sinopec Qilu Petrochemical Corp of China has been licensed with the Union Carbide/Kvaerner A/S (formerly Davy) low pressure oxo technology to expand its oxo alcohols plant in China's Shandong Province.

The expansion project, to be completed in 1999, will nearly double Sinopec Qilu's production of butyraldehydes from propylene and will subsequently increase the production of 2-ethylhexanol to 85,000 metric tonnes and butanols to 65,000 tonnes per year, Union Carbide said.
The project is part of a capital expansion program underway by Sinopec Qilu, centered on an increase in olefins production to 450,000 tonnes per year.
Sinopec Qilu's existing Union Carbide/Kvaerner low-pressure oxo plant began operations in 1986.
Upon completion of the expansion program, the company will be the largest producer of oxo chemicals in China, Union Carbide said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
